command.summary: Create a new managed Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the managed cluster.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --aad-admin-group-object-ids
parameters.help: Comma-separated list of aad group object IDs that will be set as cluster admin.

parameters.name: --aad-tenant-id
parameters.help: The ID of an Azure Active Directory tenant.

parameters.name: --aci-subnet-name
parameters.help: The name of a subnet in an existing VNet into which to deploy the virtual nodes.

parameters.name: --acns-advanced-networkpolicies
parameters.help: Enable advanced network policies (None, FQDN or L7) on a cluster when enabling advanced networking features with "-- enable-acns".

parameters.name: --acns-datapath-acceleration-mode
parameters.help: Set the datapath acceleration mode for Azure Container Networking Solution (ACNS) Performance. Valid values are 'BpfVeth' and 'None'.

parameters.name: --acns-transit-encryption-type
parameters.help: Set transit encryption type for ACNS security. Configures pod-to-pod encryption for Cilium-based clusters. Once enabled, all traffic between Cilium managed pods will be encrypted when it leaves the node boundary. Valid values are "WireGuard" and "None". On cluster creation, this must be used together with "--enable- acns".

parameters.name: --admin-username
parameters.help: User account to create on node VMs for SSH access.

parameters.name: --aks-custom-headers
parameters.help: Comma-separated key-value pairs to specify custom headers.

parameters.name: --ampls-resource-id
parameters.help: Resource ID of Azure Monitor Private Link scope for Monitoring Addon.

parameters.name: --api-server-authorized-ip-ranges
parameters.help: Comma-separated list of authorized apiserver IP ranges. Set to 0.0.0.0/32 to restrict apiserver traffic to node pools.

parameters.name: --apiserver-subnet-id
parameters.help: The ID of a subnet in an existing VNet into which to assign control plane apiserver pods(requires --enable-apiserver-vnet- integration).

parameters.name: --app-routing-default-nginx-controller
parameters.help: Configure default nginx ingress controller type. Valid values are annotationControlled (default behavior), external, internal, or none.

parameters.name: --assign-identity
parameters.help: Specify an existing user assigned identity for control plane's usage in order to manage cluster resource group.

parameters.name: --assign-kubelet-identity
parameters.help: Specify an existing user assigned identity for kubelet's usage, which is typically used to pull image from ACR.

parameters.name: --attach-acr
parameters.help: Grant the 'acrpull' role assignment to the ACR specified by name or resource ID.

parameters.name: --auto-upgrade-channel
parameters.help: Specify the upgrade channel for autoupgrade.

parameters.name: --azure-keyvault-kms-key-id
parameters.help: Identifier of Azure Key Vault key.

parameters.name: --azure-keyvault-kms-key-vault-network-access
parameters.help: Network Access of Azure Key Vault. Allowed values are "Public", "Private". If not set, defaults to type "Public". Requires --azure-keyvault-kms-key-id to be used.

parameters.name: --azure-keyvault-kms-key-vault-resource-id
parameters.help: Resource ID of Azure Key Vault.

parameters.name: --azure-monitor-workspace-resource-id
parameters.help: Resource ID of the Azure Monitor Workspace.

parameters.name: --bootstrap-artifact-source
parameters.help: Configure artifact source when bootstraping the cluster. The artifacts include the addon image. Use "Direct" to download artifacts from MCR, "Cache" to downalod artifacts from Azure Container Registry.

parameters.name: --bootstrap-container-registry-resource-id
parameters.help: Configure container registry resource ID. Must use "Cache" as bootstrap artifact source.

parameters.name: --ca-certs
parameters.help: Path to a file containing up to 10 blank line separated certificates. Only valid for Linux nodes. These certificates are used by Custom CA Trust feature and will be added to trust stores of nodes.

parameters.name: --ca-profile
parameters.help: Comma-separated list of key=value pairs for configuring cluster autoscaler. Pass an empty string to clear the profile.

parameters.name: --client-secret
parameters.help: Secret associated with the service principal. This argument is required if `--service-principal` is specified.

parameters.name: --container-storage-version
parameters.help: Set azure container storage version, the latest version will be installed by default.

parameters.name: --crg-id
parameters.help: The crg id used to associate the new cluster with the existed Capacity Reservation Group resource.

parameters.name: --data-collection-settings
parameters.help: Path to JSON file containing data collection settings for Monitoring addon.

parameters.name: --defender-config
parameters.help: Path to JSON file containing Microsoft Defender profile configurations.

parameters.name: --disable-acns-observability
parameters.help: Used to disable advanced networking observability features on a clusters when enabling advanced networking features with "--enable-acns".

parameters.name: --disable-acns-security
parameters.help: Used to disable advanced networking security features on a clusters when enabling advanced networking features with "--enable-acns".

parameters.name: --disable-disk-driver
parameters.help: Disable AzureDisk CSI Driver.

parameters.name: --disable-file-driver
parameters.help: Disable AzureFile CSI Driver.

parameters.name: --disable-local-accounts
parameters.help: If set to true, getting static credential will be disabled for this cluster.

parameters.name: --disable-public-fqdn
parameters.help: Disable public fqdn feature for private cluster.

parameters.name: --disable-rbac
parameters.help: Disable Kubernetes Role-Based Access Control.

parameters.name: --disable-run-command
parameters.help: Disable Run command feature for the cluster.

parameters.name: --disable-snapshot-controller
parameters.help: Disable CSI Snapshot Controller.

parameters.name: --dns-name-prefix
parameters.help: Prefix for hostnames that are created. If not specified, generate a hostname using the managed cluster and resource group names.

parameters.name: --dns-service-ip
parameters.help: An IP address assigned to the Kubernetes DNS service. This address must be within the Kubernetes service address range specified by "--service- cidr". For example, 10.0.0.10.

parameters.name: --edge-zone
parameters.help: The name of the Edge Zone.

parameters.name: --enable-aad
parameters.help: Enable managed AAD feature for cluster.

parameters.name: --enable-acns
parameters.help: Enable advanced network functionalities on a cluster. Enabling this will incur additional costs. For non-cilium clusters, acns security will be disabled by default until further notice.

parameters.name: --enable-addons
parameters.help: Enable the Kubernetes addons in a comma- separated list. These addons are available: - http_application_routing: configure ingress with automatic public DNS name creation. - monitoring: turn on Log Analytics monitoring. Uses the Log Analytics Default Workspace if it exists, else creates one. Specify "--workspace-resource-id" to use an existing workspace. Specify "--enable-msi-auth-for-monitoring" to use Managed Identity Auth. Specify "--enable-syslog" to enable syslog data collection from nodes. Note MSI must be enabled Specify "--data-collection-settings" to configure data collection settings Specify "--ampls-resource-id" for private link. Note MSI must be enabled. Specify "--enable-high-log-scale-mode" to enable high log scale mode for container logs. Note MSI must be enabled. If monitoring addon is enabled --no-wait argument will have no effect - azure-policy: enable Azure policy. The Azure Policy add-on for AKS enables at-scale enforcements and safeguards on your clusters in a centralized, consistent manner. Learn more at aka.ms/aks/policy. - virtual-node: enable AKS Virtual Node. Requires --aci-subnet-name to provide the name of an existing subnet for the Virtual Node to use. aci-subnet-name must be in the same vnet which is specified by --vnet-subnet-id (required as well). - confcom: enable confcom addon, this will enable SGX device plugin by default. - open-service-mesh: enable Open Service Mesh addon. - azure-keyvault-secrets-provider: enable Azure Keyvault Secrets Provider addon.

parameters.name: --enable-ahub
parameters.help: Enable Azure Hybrid User Benefits (AHUB) for Windows VMs.

parameters.name: --enable-ai-toolchain-operator
parameters.help: Enable AI toolchain operator to the cluster.

parameters.name: --enable-apiserver-vnet-integration
parameters.help: Enable integration of user vnet with control plane apiserver pods.

parameters.name: --enable-app-routing
parameters.help: Enable Application Routing addon.

parameters.name: --enable-app-routing-istio
parameters.help: Enable Gateway API based ingress on App Routing via Istio without service mesh functionality. This enables an ingress-only version of Istio that reconciles Gateway API resources for App Routing. It does not provide service mesh functionality (e.g. mTLS, traffic management between services). Cannot be used simultaneously with the Istio service mesh add-on (--enable-azure-service- mesh).

parameters.name: --enable-asm
parameters.help: Enable Azure Service Mesh addon.

parameters.name: --enable-azure-container-storage
parameters.help: Enable azure container storage. Can be used as a flag (defaults to True) or with a storage pool type value: (azureDisk, ephemeralDisk, elasticSan).

parameters.name: --enable-azure-keyvault-kms
parameters.help: Enable Azure KeyVault Key Management Service.

parameters.name: --enable-azure-monitor-app-monitoring
parameters.help: Enable Azure Monitor Application Monitoring auto-instrumentation for a Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: --enable-azure-monitor-metrics
parameters.help: Enable a kubernetes cluster with the Azure Monitor managed service for Prometheus integration.

parameters.name: --enable-azure-rbac
parameters.help: Enable Azure RBAC to control authorization checks on cluster.

parameters.name: --enable-blob-driver
parameters.help: Enable AzureBlob CSI Driver.

parameters.name: --enable-cluster-autoscaler
parameters.help: Enable cluster autoscaler, default value is false. If specified, please make sure the kubernetes version is larger than 1.10.6.

parameters.name: --enable-container-network-logs
parameters.help: Enable container network log collection functionalities on a cluster. Automatically enables --enable-high-log-scale-mode.

parameters.name: --enable-control-plane-metrics
parameters.help: Enable collection of Azure Monitor managed Prometheus control plane metrics for managed cluster components (controlplane- apiserver and controlplane-etcd targets by default). Requires Azure Monitor metrics to be enabled (already enabled or via --enable-azure-monitor-metrics).

parameters.name: --enable-cost-analysis
parameters.help: Enable exporting Kubernetes Namespace and Deployment details to the Cost Analysis views in the Azure portal. For more information see aka.ms/aks/docs/cost- analysis.

parameters.name: --enable-defender
parameters.help: Enable Microsoft Defender security profile.

parameters.name: --enable-encryption-at-host
parameters.help: Enable EncryptionAtHost, default value is false.

parameters.name: --enable-fips-image
parameters.help: Use FIPS-enabled OS on agent nodes.

parameters.name: --enable-gateway-api
parameters.help: Enable managed installation of Gateway API CRDs from the standard release channel.

parameters.name: --enable-high-log-scale-mode
parameters.help: Enable High Log Scale Mode for Container Logs. Auto-enabled when --enable-container- network-logs is specified.

parameters.name: --enable-hosted-system
parameters.help: (Automatic SKU) Explicitly opt in to a Managed System Pool for the Automatic cluster. Only valid with `--sku automatic`. Use this flag when you want to deterministically request a Managed System Pool regardless of region defaults. It is also implied when you supply the bring-your-own VNet subnet trio (`--system-node-subnet-id`, `--node-subnet-id`, `--apiserver-subnet-id`).

parameters.name: --enable-image-cleaner
parameters.help: Enable ImageCleaner Service.

parameters.name: --enable-keda
parameters.help: Enable KEDA workload auto-scaler.

parameters.name: --enable-managed-identity
parameters.help: Using a system assigned managed identity to manage cluster resource group. You can explicitly specify "--service-principal" and "--client-secret" to disable managed identity, otherwise it will be enabled.

parameters.name: --enable-msi-auth-for-monitoring
parameters.help: Enable Managed Identity Auth for Monitoring addon.

parameters.name: --enable-node-public-ip
parameters.help: Enable VMSS or VMs node public IP.

parameters.name: --enable-oidc-issuer
parameters.help: Enable OIDC issuer.

parameters.name: --enable-private-cluster
parameters.help: Enable private cluster.

parameters.name: --enable-secret-rotation
parameters.help: Enable secret rotation. Use with azure- keyvault-secrets-provider addon.

parameters.name: --enable-secure-boot
parameters.help: Enable Secure Boot on all node pools in the cluster. Must use VMSS or VMs agent pool type.

parameters.name: --enable-sgxquotehelper
parameters.help: Enable SGX quote helper for confcom addon.

parameters.name: --enable-static-egress-gateway
parameters.help: Enable Static Egress Gateway addon to the cluster.

parameters.name: --enable-syslog
parameters.help: Enable syslog data collection for Monitoring addon.

parameters.name: --enable-ultra-ssd
parameters.help: Enable UltraSSD, default value is false.

parameters.name: --enable-vpa
parameters.help: Enable vertical pod autoscaler for cluster.

parameters.name: --enable-vtpm
parameters.help: Enable vTPM on all node pools in the cluster. Must use VMSS or VMs agent pool type.

parameters.name: --enable-windows-gmsa
parameters.help: Enable Windows gmsa.

parameters.name: --enable-windows-recording-rules
parameters.help: Enable Windows Recording Rules when enabling the Azure Monitor Metrics addon.

parameters.name: --enable-workload-identity
parameters.help: Enable workload identity addon.

parameters.name: --ephemeral-disk-nvme-perf-tier
parameters.help: Set ephemeral disk volume type for azure container storage.

parameters.name: --ephemeral-disk-volume-type
parameters.help: Set ephemeral disk volume type for azure container storage.

parameters.name: --fqdn-subdomain
parameters.help: Prefix for FQDN that is created for private cluster with custom private dns zone scenario.

parameters.name: --generate-ssh-keys
parameters.help: Generate SSH public and private key files if missing. The keys will be stored in the ~/.ssh directory.

parameters.name: --gmsa-dns-server
parameters.help: Specify DNS server for Windows gmsa for this cluster. You do not need to set this if you have set DNS server in the VNET used by the cluster. You must set or not set --gmsa-dns-server and --gmsa-root-domain-name at the same time when setting --enable-windows-gmsa.

parameters.name: --gmsa-root-domain-name
parameters.help: Specify root domain name for Windows gmsa for this cluster. You do not need to set this if you have set DNS server in the VNET used by the cluster. You must set or not set --gmsa-dns-server and --gmsa-root-domain-name at the same time when setting --enable-windows-gmsa.

parameters.name: --gpu-instance-profile
parameters.help: GPU instance profile to partition multi-gpu Nvidia GPUs.

parameters.name: --grafana-resource-id
parameters.help: Resource ID of the Azure Managed Grafana Workspace.

parameters.name: --host-group-id
parameters.help: The fully qualified dedicated host group id used to provision agent node pool.

parameters.name: --http-proxy-config
parameters.help: HTTP Proxy configuration for this cluster.

parameters.name: --if-match
parameters.help: The value provided will be compared to the ETag of the managed cluster, if it matches the operation will proceed. If it does not match, the request will be rejected to prevent accidental overwrites. This must not be specified when creating a new cluster.

parameters.name: --if-none-match
parameters.help: Set to '*' to allow a new cluster to be created, but to prevent updating an existing cluster. Other values will be ignored.

parameters.name: --image-cleaner-interval-hours
parameters.help: ImageCleaner scanning interval.

parameters.name: --ip-families
parameters.help: A comma-separated list of IP versions to use for cluster networking. Each IP version should be in the format IPvN. For example, IPv4.

parameters.name: --k8s-support-plan
parameters.help: Choose from "KubernetesOfficial" or "AKSLongTermSupport", with "AKSLongTermSupport" you get 1 extra year of CVE patchs.

parameters.name: --ksm-metric-annotations-allow-list
parameters.help: Comma-separated list of additional Kubernetes label keys that will be used in the resource' labels metric. By default the metric contains only name and namespace labels. To include additional labels provide a list of resource names in their plural form and Kubernetes label keys you would like to allow for them (e.g.'=namespa ces=[k8s-label-1,k8s-label- n,...],pods=[app],...)'. A single '*' can be provided per resource instead to allow any labels, but that has severe performance implications (e.g. '=pods=[*]').

parameters.name: --ksm-metric-labels-allow-list
parameters.help: Comma-separated list of additional Kubernetes label keys that will be used in the resource' labels metric. By default the metric contains only name and namespace labels. To include additional labels provide a list of resource names in their plural form and Kubernetes label keys you would like to allow for them (e.g. '=namesp aces=[k8s-label-1,k8s-label- n,...],pods=[app],...)'. A single '*' can be provided per resource instead to allow any labels, but that has severe performance implications (e.g. '=pods=[*]').

parameters.name: --kubelet-config
parameters.help: Path to JSON file containing Kubelet configurations for agent nodes. https://aka.ms/aks/custom-node-config.

parameters.name: --kubernetes-version
parameters.help: Version of Kubernetes to use for creating the cluster, such as "1.16.9".

parameters.name: --linux-os-config
parameters.help: Path to JSON file containing OS configurations for Linux agent nodes. https://aka.ms/aks/custom-node-config.

parameters.name: --load-balancer-backend-pool-type
parameters.help: Load balancer backend pool type. Define the LoadBalancer backend pool type of managed inbound backend pool. The nodeIP means the VMs will be attached to the LoadBalancer by adding its private IP address to the backend pool. The nodeIPConfiguration means the VMs will be attached to the LoadBalancer by referencing the backend pool ID in the VM's NIC.

parameters.name: --load-balancer-idle-timeout
parameters.help: Load balancer idle timeout in minutes. Desired idle timeout for load balancer outbound flows, default is 30 minutes. Please specify a value in the range of [4, 100].

parameters.name: --load-balancer-managed-outbound-ip-count
parameters.help: Load balancer managed outbound IP count. Desired number of managed outbound IPs for load balancer outbound connection. Valid for Standard SKU load balancer cluster only.

parameters.name: --load-balancer-managed-outbound-ipv6-count
parameters.help: Load balancer managed outbound IPv6 IP count. Desired number of managed outbound IPv6 IPs for load balancer outbound connection. Valid for dual-stack (--ip-families IPv4,IPv6) only.

parameters.name: --load-balancer-outbound-ip-prefixes
parameters.help: Load balancer outbound IP prefix resource IDs. Comma-separated public IP prefix resource IDs for load balancer outbound connection. Valid for Standard SKU load balancer cluster only.

parameters.name: --load-balancer-outbound-ips
parameters.help: Load balancer outbound IP resource IDs. Comma-separated public IP resource IDs for load balancer outbound connection. Valid for Standard SKU load balancer cluster only.

parameters.name: --load-balancer-outbound-ports
parameters.help: Load balancer outbound allocated ports. Desired static number of outbound ports per VM in the load balancer backend pool. By default, set to 0 which uses the default allocation based on the number of VMs.

parameters.name: --load-balancer-sku
parameters.help: Azure Load Balancer SKU selection for your cluster. basic or standard. Defaults to 'standard'. Select between Basic or Standard Azure Load Balancer SKU for your AKS cluster.

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --max-count
parameters.help: Maximum nodes count used for autoscaler, when "--enable-cluster-autoscaler" specified. Please specify the value in the range of [1, 1000].

parameters.name: --max-pods
parameters.help: The maximum number of pods deployable to a node. If not specified, defaults based on network-plugin. 30 for "azure", 110 for "kubenet", or 250 for "none".

parameters.name: --message-of-the-day
parameters.help: Path to a file containing the desired message of the day. Only valid for linux nodes. Will be written to /etc/motd.

parameters.name: --min-count
parameters.help: Minimum nodes count used for autoscaler, when "--enable-cluster-autoscaler" specified. Please specify the value in the range of [1, 1000].

parameters.name: --nat-gateway-idle-timeout
parameters.help: NAT gateway idle timeout in minutes. Desired idle timeout for NAT gateway outbound flows, default is 4 minutes. Please specify a value in the range of [4, 120]. Valid for Standard SKU load balancer cluster with managedNATGateway outbound type only.

parameters.name: --nat-gateway-managed-outbound-ip-count
parameters.help: NAT gateway managed outbound IP count. Desired number of managed outbound IPs for NAT gateway outbound connection. Please specify a value in the range of [1, 16]. Valid for Standard SKU load balancer cluster with managedNATGateway outbound type only.

parameters.name: --network-dataplane
parameters.help: The network dataplane to use. Network dataplane used in the Kubernetes cluster. Specify "azure" to use the Azure dataplane (default) or "cilium" to enable Cilium dataplane.

parameters.name: --network-plugin
parameters.help: The Kubernetes network plugin to use. Specify "azure" for highly scalable networking, "kubenet" for IP assignment from subnet NAT- based routing, or "none" for no networking configured. Defaults to "azure".

parameters.name: --network-plugin-mode
parameters.help: The network plugin mode to use. Used to control the mode the network plugin should operate in. Defaults to "overlay". If not specified with "azure" as network plugin, pods are given routable IPs from VNET.

parameters.name: --network-policy
parameters.help: Network Policy Engine to use. Azure provides three Network Policy Engines for enforcing network policies that can be used together with "azure" network plugin. The following values can be specified: - "azure" for Azure Network Policy Manager, - "cilium" for Azure CNI Powered by Cilium, - "calico" for open-source network and network security solution founded by Tigera, - "none" when no Network Policy Engine is installed (default value). Defaults to "none" (network policy disabled).

parameters.name: --no-ssh-key
parameters.help: Do not use or create a local SSH key. If omitted and no local public key exists, the CLI will default to this behavior. To access nodes after creating a cluster with this option, use the Azure Portal.

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --node-count
parameters.help: Number of nodes in the Kubernetes node pool. After creating a cluster, you can change the size of its node pool with `az aks scale`.

parameters.name: --node-os-upgrade-channel
parameters.help: Manner in which the OS on your nodes is updated. It could be NodeImage, None, SecurityPatch or Unmanaged.

parameters.name: --node-osdisk-diskencryptionset-id
parameters.help: ResourceId of the disk encryption set to use for enabling encryption at rest on agent node os disk.

parameters.name: --node-osdisk-size
parameters.help: Size in GiB of the OS disk for each node in the node pool. Minimum 30 GiB.

parameters.name: --node-osdisk-type
parameters.help: OS disk type to be used for machines in a given agent pool: Ephemeral or Managed. Defaults to 'Ephemeral' when possible in conjunction with VM size and OS disk size. May not be changed for this pool after creation.

parameters.name: --node-provisioning-default-pools
parameters.help: The set of default Karpenter NodePools configured for node provisioning. Valid values are "Auto" and "None". The set of default Karpenter NodePools configured for node provisioning. Valid values are "Auto" and "None". Auto: A standard set of Karpenter NodePools are provisioned. None: No Karpenter NodePools are provisioned. WARNING: Changing this from Auto to None on an existing cluster will cause the default Karpenter NodePools to be deleted, which will in turn drain and delete the nodes associated with those pools. It is strongly recommended to not do this unless there are idle nodes ready to take the pods evicted by that action.

parameters.name: --node-provisioning-mode
parameters.help: Set the node provisioning mode of the cluster. Valid values are "Auto" and "Manual". For more information on "Auto" mode see aka.ms/aks/nap.

parameters.name: --node-public-ip-prefix-id
parameters.help: Public IP prefix ID used to assign public IPs to VMSS or VMs nodes.

parameters.name: --node-public-ip-tags
parameters.help: The ipTags of the node public IPs.

parameters.name: --node-resource-group
parameters.help: The node resource group is the resource group where all customer's resources will be created in, such as virtual machines.

parameters.name: --node-subnet-id
parameters.help: (Automatic SKU) The ID of a subnet in an existing VNet to be used by user node pools in an Automatic cluster. Bring-your-own VNet for an Automatic cluster requires three subnets supplied together: `--system-node-subnet-id` (for the Managed System Pool), `--node-subnet-id` (this flag, for user node pools), and `--apiserver-subnet-id` (for the control plane API server). All three subnets must belong to the same VNet and can only be used with `--sku automatic`.

parameters.name: --node-vm-size
parameters.help: Size of Virtual Machines to create as Kubernetes nodes. If the user does not specify one, server will select a default VM size for her/him.

parameters.name: --nodepool-allowed-host-ports
parameters.help: Expose host ports on the node pool. When specified, format should be a space- separated list of ranges with protocol, eg. `80/TCP 443/TCP 4000-5000/TCP`.

parameters.name: --nodepool-asg-ids
parameters.help: The IDs of the application security groups to which the node pool's network interface should belong. When specified, format should be a space-separated list of IDs.

parameters.name: --nodepool-labels
parameters.help: The node labels for all node pool. See https://aka.ms/node-labels for syntax of labels.

parameters.name: --nodepool-name
parameters.help: Node pool name, up to 12 alphanumeric characters.

parameters.name: --nodepool-tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use "" to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --nodepool-taints
parameters.help: The node taints for all node pool.

parameters.name: --nrg-lockdown-restriction-level
parameters.help: Restriction level on the managed node resource group. The restriction level of permissions allowed on the cluster's managed node resource group, supported values are Unrestricted, and ReadOnly (recommended ReadOnly).

parameters.name: --os-sku
parameters.help: The OS SKU of the agent node pool. Ubuntu, AzureLinux, AzureLinux3, AzureContainerLinux, Ubuntu2204, or Ubuntu2404.

parameters.name: --outbound-type
parameters.help: How outbound traffic will be configured for a cluster. Select between loadBalancer, userDefinedRouting, managedNATGateway, userAssignedNATGateway and none. If not set, defaults to type loadBalancer. Requires --vnet-subnet-id to be provided with a preconfigured route table and --load-balancer-sku to be Standard.

parameters.name: --pod-cidr
parameters.help: A CIDR notation IP range from which to assign pod IPs when Azure CNI Overlay or Kubenet is used (On 31 March 2028, Kubenet will be retired). This range must not overlap with any Subnet IP ranges. For example, 172.244.0.0/16. See https://aka.ms/aks/azure-cni-overlay.

parameters.name: --pod-cidrs
parameters.help: A comma-separated list of CIDR notation IP ranges from which to assign pod IPs when Azure CNI Overlay or Kubenet is used (On 31 March 2028, Kubenet will be retired). Each range must not overlap with any Subnet IP ranges. For example, "172.244.0.0/16,fd0:abcd::/64". See https://aka.ms/aks/azure-cni-overlay.

parameters.name: --pod-ip-allocation-mode
parameters.help: Set the ip allocation mode for how Pod IPs from the Azure Pod Subnet are allocated to the nodes in the AKS cluster. The choice is between dynamic batches of individual IPs or static allocation of a set of CIDR blocks. Accepted Values are "DynamicIndividual" or "StaticBlock". Used together with the "azure" network plugin. Requires --pod-subnet-id.

parameters.name: --pod-subnet-id
parameters.help: The ID of a subnet in an existing VNet into which to assign pods in the cluster (requires azure network-plugin).

parameters.name: --ppg
parameters.help: The ID of a PPG.

parameters.name: --private-dns-zone
parameters.help: Private dns zone mode for private cluster. Allowed values are "system", "none" or custom private dns zone resource id. If not set, defaults to type system. Requires --enable-private-cluster to be used.

parameters.name: --revision
parameters.help: Azure Service Mesh revision to install.

parameters.name: --rotation-poll-interval
parameters.help: Set interval of rotation poll. Use with azure-keyvault-secrets-provider addon.

parameters.name: --service-cidr
parameters.help: A CIDR notation IP range from which to assign service cluster IPs. This range must not overlap with any Subnet IP ranges. For example, 10.0.0.0/16.

parameters.name: --service-cidrs
parameters.help: A comma-separated list of CIDR notation IP ranges from which to assign service cluster IPs. Each range must not overlap with any Subnet IP ranges. For example, "10.0.0.0/16,2001:abcd::/108".

parameters.name: --service-principal
parameters.help: Service principal used for authentication to Azure APIs.

parameters.name: --skip-subnet-role-assignment
parameters.help: Skip role assignment for subnet (advanced networking). If specified, please make sure your service principal has the access to your subnet.

parameters.name: --sku
parameters.help: Specify SKU name for managed clusters. Use '--sku base' enables a base managed cluster. Use '--sku automatic' enables an automatic managed cluster.

parameters.name: --snapshot-id
parameters.help: The source snapshot id used to create this cluster.

parameters.name: --ssh-key-value
parameters.help: Public key path or key contents to install on node VMs for SSH access. For example, 'ssh-rsa AAAAB...snip...UcyupgH azureuser@linuxvm'. If omitted: - The CLI will use '~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub' when present - If that file is not present the CLI will default to server-side generated keys (equivalent to using --no-ssh-key).

parameters.name: --storage-pool-name
parameters.help: Set storage pool name for azure container storage.

parameters.name: --storage-pool-option
parameters.help: Set ephemeral disk storage pool option for azure container storage.

parameters.name: --storage-pool-size
parameters.help: Set storage pool size for azure container storage.

parameters.name: --storage-pool-sku
parameters.help: Set azure disk type storage pool sku for azure container storage.

parameters.name: --system-node-subnet-id
parameters.help: (Automatic SKU) The ID of a subnet in an existing VNet to be used by the Managed System Pool in an Automatic cluster. Bring-your-own VNet for an Automatic cluster requires three subnets supplied together: `--system-node-subnet-id` (this flag, for the Managed System Pool), `--node-subnet-id` (for user node pools), and `--apiserver-subnet-id` (for the control plane API server). All three subnets must belong to the same VNet and can only be used with `--sku automatic`.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: The tags of the managed cluster. The managed cluster instance and all resources managed by the cloud provider will be tagged.

parameters.name: --tier
parameters.help: Specify SKU tier for managed clusters. '-- tier standard' enables a standard managed cluster service with a financially backed SLA. '--tier free' does not have a financially backed SLA.

parameters.name: --vm-set-type
parameters.help: Agent pool vm set type. VirtualMachineScaleSets or AvailabilitySet or VirtualMachines. Defaults to 'VirtualMachineScaleSets'.

parameters.name: --vm-sizes
parameters.help: Comma-separated list of VM sizes. Valid for VirtualMachines node pool only. If `--vm- sizes` not specified but `--node-vm-size` specified, value of `--node-vm-size` will be used. If neither of them specified, defaults to Standard_DS2_v2 for Linux or Standard_D2s_v3 for Windows.

parameters.name: --vnet-subnet-id
parameters.help: The ID of a subnet in an existing VNet into which to deploy the cluster.

parameters.name: --windows-admin-password
parameters.help: User account password to use on windows node VMs. Rules for windows-admin-password: - Minimum-length: 14 characters - Max-length: 123 characters - Complexity requirements: 3 out of 4 conditions below need to be fulfilled * Has lower characters * Has upper characters * Has a digit * Has a special character (Regex match [\W_]) - Disallowed values: "abc@123", "P@$$w0rd", "P@ssw0rd", "P@ssword123", "Pa$$word", "pass@word1", "Password!", "Password1", "Password22", "iloveyou!" Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.azure.management.compute.models. virtualmachinescalesetosprofile.adminpassword?view=azure-dotnet.

parameters.name: --windows-admin-username
parameters.help: User account to create on windows node VMs. Rules for windows-admin-username: - restriction: Cannot end in "." - Disallowed values: "administrator", "admin", "user", "user1", "test", "user2", "test1", "user3", "admin1", "1", "123", "a", "actuser", "adm", "admin2", "aspnet", "backup", "console", "david", "guest", "john", "owner", "root", "server", "sql", "support", "support_388945a0", "sys", "test2", "test3", "user4", "user5". - Minimum-length: 1 character - Max-length: 20 characters Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.azure.management.compute.models. virtualmachinescalesetosprofile.adminusername?view=azure-dotnet.

parameters.name: --workload-runtime
parameters.help: Set the workload runtime. Azure provides a different workload-runtime to enable Kata supported workloads in your nodepools. The following values can be specified: - "KataVmIsolation" for Kata.

parameters.name: --workspace-resource-id
parameters.help: The resource ID of an existing Log Analytics Workspace to use for storing monitoring data. If not specified, uses the default Log Analytics Workspace if it exists, otherwise creates one.

parameters.name: --yes
parameters.help: Do not prompt for confirmation.

parameters.name: --zones
parameters.help: Availability zones where agent nodes will be placed. Also, to install agent nodes to more than one zones you need to pass zone numbers (1,2 or 3) separated by blanks. For example - To have all 3 zones, you are expected to enter `--zones 1 2 3`.

parameters.name: --appgw-id
parameters.help: Resource Id of an existing Application Gateway to use with AGIC. Use with ingress- azure addon.

parameters.name: --appgw-name
parameters.help: Name of the application gateway to create/use in the node resource group. Use with ingress-azure addon.

parameters.name: --appgw-subnet-cidr
parameters.help: Subnet CIDR to use for a new subnet created to deploy the Application Gateway. Use with ingress-azure addon.

parameters.name: --appgw-subnet-id
parameters.help: Resource Id of an existing Subnet used to deploy the Application Gateway. Use with ingress-azure addon.

parameters.name: --appgw-watch-namespace
parameters.help: Specify the namespace, which AGIC should watch. This could be a single string value, or a comma-separated list of namespaces.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
